mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have beautiful clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 73 degrees. Also, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 8:38 PM, rising in the west-southwest over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the south-southwest near Belleville.

The Verona Plan Commission has an upcoming agenda for their meeting on October 5th, which includes reviewing certified survey maps and site plans for several locations, such as 201 South Main Street and various properties in the Town of Verona. Additionally, the city is managing several pending projects, including site plans for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

It is a busy couple of days in Verona. Yoga at Insight Wellness is scheduled for today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, we have live music and the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park this Wednesday.

In a report covering September 14th through September 28th, officers handled a variety of incidents. Notably, on September 21st, a retail theft involving candy was reported at a business on East Verona Avenue, where the individual was identified and cited.
You can enjoy the delicious OREO Cookie Cheesecake flavor of the day at Culver's, which is currently open and serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
